GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, plodded home # never a threat
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, found little and plodded home # Slow Recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported his mount never felt entirely comfortable during the event and was disappointing in its failure to respond over the concluding stages. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be slow to recover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 5l off, running on held up passing 200m, clear passing 100m hit line well late once clear # held up/excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m became badly unbalanced after clipping heels. Rdr was reprimanded for persisting to pressure mnt after run had closed and had become awkwardly placed. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear 9 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist, ridden quiet To The Turn = imposs task, clear run home Outside kept trying without threatening Inconclusive (t/t/1st, v/1st) # sat too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners at the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down 8th Inside 9 Lengths No Pace On = task, held-up x 600m 7 Lengths Hard Ridden 400m Made Good Ground to 100m then Couldn'T Go On - # run ended 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6-7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong # best work late

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down last 9 Lengths off leader/winner Not Enough Pace On = big task, went wide Straightening Up 7th x 200m 6th x line, Sound Effort ! - # sprint home against
